tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: Display Chronological Feed of League Moments
stories.goal: view a chronological feed of all league activity and moments
stories.benefit: I can stay up-to-date with everything happening in my league in one central location
acceptanceCriteria: Feed displays moments in reverse chronological order (newest first) by default
Each moment card shows timestamp, moment type, and relevant content preview
Feed includes all moment types: trades, match results, commissioner posts, user posts, power rankings, predictions
Infinite scroll loads older moments as user scrolls down
Feed automatically updates with new moments without requiring page refresh

stories.title: Generate Automated Trade Moments
stories.goal: automatically create feed moments when trades are processed in the connected fantasy league
stories.benefit: league members are immediately notified of trade activity without manual posting
acceptanceCriteria: System detects new trades from Sleeper API sync and creates trade moment records
Trade moment displays teams involved, players/picks exchanged, and trade timestamp
Trade moment includes visual representation of assets moving between teams
System handles multi-team trades correctly showing all parties involved
Trade moments appear in feed immediately upon detection during sync

stories.title: Generate Automated Match Result Moments
stories.goal: automatically create feed moments when weekly matchups are completed
stories.benefit: members can quickly see all match results without navigating to separate pages
acceptanceCriteria: System creates match result moments after stat corrections are finalized
Match result moment displays both teams, final scores, and winning team
Moment highlights close games and blowouts with appropriate visual emphasis
System creates separate moments for playoff matchups with special formatting
Match result moments link to full matchup detail page

stories.title: Publish Commissioner Content as Feed Moments
stories.goal: have my published power rankings and predictions automatically appear in the feed
stories.benefit: my weekly content reaches all league members through the main feed
acceptanceCriteria: Published power rankings create a feed moment with rankings preview and link to full rankings page
Published matchup predictions create feed moment showing featured matchup and prediction
Commissioner desk publish action creates all applicable moments in single transaction
Moments include commissioner commentary snippets as preview text
Feed moments link back to full content pages for complete details

stories.title: Create User-Generated Post Moments
stories.goal: create a post that appears in the league feed for other members to see
stories.benefit: I can share thoughts, trash talk, or league-related content with everyone
acceptanceCriteria: User can create text post with compose interface in feed or dedicated modal
Post supports basic text formatting (paragraphs, line breaks)
Created post appears in feed immediately with author attribution and timestamp
User can edit or delete their own posts after creation
Posts display user's role (Manager/Fan) and team affiliation if applicable

stories.title: Implement Engagement-Based Feed Sorting
stories.goal: surface recently engaged moments higher in feed to promote active discussions
stories.benefit: members see trending conversations and don't miss active discussions buried by new posts
acceptanceCriteria: Feed sorting algorithm considers recency of comments and reactions in addition to moment creation time
Moments with recent engagement (within 24 hours) receive sorting boost
User can toggle between 'Recent' (engagement-aware) and 'Chronological' (strict time order) sorting
Engagement bumping applies to all moment types equally
System prevents spam or abuse from manipulating feed order through rate limiting

stories.title: Bump Moments on New Comments
stories.goal: move moments to top of engagement-aware feed when new comments are added
stories.benefit: active discussions remain visible and members can easily find ongoing conversations
acceptanceCriteria: Adding comment to moment updates moment's 'last activity' timestamp
Moment with new comment moves higher in feed when 'Recent' sorting is active
Bumping respects pinned moments which remain at top regardless of activity
System tracks separate creation time and last activity time for each moment
Feed UI indicates when moment was bumped vs originally created

stories.title: Bump Moments on New Reactions
stories.goal: update moment position in feed when users add emoji reactions
stories.benefit: moments receiving engagement stay prominent even without text comments
acceptanceCriteria: Adding reaction to moment updates moment's last activity timestamp
Reactions contribute to engagement score for sorting purposes
Multiple reactions from same user within short time window count as single engagement event
Removing reactions does not trigger negative bump or reverse sorting
Feed sorting balances reactions and comments appropriately (comments weighted higher)

stories.title: Display Moment Type Indicators
stories.goal: quickly identify the type of each moment in the feed at a glance
stories.benefit: I can scan the feed efficiently and focus on moment types most interesting to me
acceptanceCriteria: Each moment card displays clear visual indicator of moment type (icon or badge)
Moment types include: Trade, Match Result, Power Rankings, Prediction, Commissioner Post, User Post, Transaction
Type indicators use consistent color scheme and iconography across feed
User can filter feed by moment type to see only specific categories
Mobile view maintains type indicators in condensed card format

stories.title: Generate Automated Transaction Moments for Waivers and Free Agents
stories.goal: automatically create feed moments for significant waiver and free agent transactions
stories.benefit: members stay informed about roster moves without checking transaction page separately
acceptanceCriteria: System creates moments for waiver claims and free agent pickups detected in sync
Transaction moments display team, players acquired/dropped, and transaction type
System uses thresholds to avoid flooding feed (e.g., only notable players or batch summaries)
Transaction moments automatically promoted to newsfeed when they receive engagement
Moments link to full transaction detail and transaction history page
